name: service-status
description: Recognize third-party outages (GitHub, npm, AI APIs, clouds) and check status pages cheaply from Codex. Pair with service-status-hook for automatic nudges.

interface.shortDescription: Know when it's them, not you
interface.longDescription: When a git, gh, package-manager or API call fails like an outage, check the provider's status page with a minimal fetch before changing any code.
defaultPrompt: Check whether npm is having an incident
Why did git push fail with a 503?
